extraction_notes: Main performance data are in Figure 1a,b; most values other than the text-printed Pd-Pt/In2O3 300 °C CO2 conversion (17.7 %) and methanol STY (0.73 gMeOH gcat-1 h−1) were read approximately from plotted bars/points and marked with qualifier '~'. Figure 1c is a dense 45 h time-on-stream plot for Pd-Pt/In2O3 at 300 °C; individual data points could not be read reliably from the supplied image, so they were not enumerated. Table S1 is described as a literature comparison and was not included.
